_comment: Discovery surface for the COMPONENTS universe. Capture only: nothing here
scores, grades, ranks or publishes anything. Queries are sent to the public
npm and PyPI registry APIs; every returned package name is tested against
Patterns and queries may be ADDED. Removing one drops a package silently out
of the capture set and leaves a permanent hole in the record, so removals are
rejected by capture/append_only_guard.py the same way company domains are.
